source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7 with Example 4.4 (PDF 85-87).

blocks.text: Jab bhi jism par kaam ho to us ki energy barhti hai. Maslan, agar force F mass m ke jism par, jo shuru mein velocity vi se chal raha hai, faasle d tak lage aur us ki velocity vf kar de, to paida acceleration 2ad = vf^2 - vi^2 se milta hai, ya a = (vf^2 - vi^2)/(2d) ... (4.16). Doosre qanoon-e-harkat se F = ma, ya a = F/m ... (4.17). Eqs. 4.16 aur 4.17 ka muqabla karne par F/m = (vf^2 - vi^2)/(2d), ya F d = (1/2) m vf^2 - (1/2) m vi^2 ... (4.18). Yeh expression work-energy theorem hai.

blocks.title: Work-energy theorem
blocks.text: Cheez ki kinetic energy ki tabdeeli us par khalis force ke kiye kaam ke barabar hai: W = kinetic energy ki tabdeeli = (KE)f - (KE)i = (1/2) m vf^2 - (1/2) m vi^2. Ise work-energy principle bhi kehte hain.

Work-energy theorem displacement ki nisbat force ki kisi bhi simt ke liye lagu hai. Maslan, kinetic energy wali cheez kaam kar sakti hai agar use kisi doosri cheez ko dhakelne ya kheenchne diya jaye; is soorat mein kaam manfi liya jata hai aur cheez ki kinetic energy ghatti hai. Theorem tab bhi durust rehti hai jab force nuqte ba nuqta badle.

blocks.title: Example 4.4
blocks.text: 60 kg wazan ka motorcycle sawar 24-degree dhalan se neeche coast karta hai; motorcycle ka wazan 30 kg hai. Dhalan ki choti par speed 3.2 m s^-1 hai. Agar kinetic raghrat ki force 100 N ho to 72 m neeche speed kya hogi? Hal: normal force F_N dhalan par amood wazan ke component (mg cos 24) se mutawazan hai. Kinetic raghrat ki force f ke saath khalis force F, F = mg sin 24 - f hai, jahan m = kul mass = 60 kg + 30 kg = 90 kg: F = (90 kg x 9.8 m s^-2 x 0.4) - 100 N = 252.8 N. Kiya kaam W = F d = 252.8 N x 72 m = 18201.6 J. Chunke kaam musbat hai, work-energy theorem W = (KE)f - (KE)i lagane par (KE)f = W + (KE)i: (1/2) m vf^2 = W + (1/2) m vi^2, (1/2) x 90 kg x vf^2 = 18201 J + (1/2) x 90 kg x (3.2 m s^-1)^2. Is se vf^2 = 414.7 m^2 s^-2, ya vf = sqrt(414.7) = 20.4 m s^-1.

blocks.alt: Sawar ke saath motorcycle ek seedhi dhalan (slope) par jo ufqi zameen se 24 degree par daen taraf uthti hai.
blocks.caption: Example 4.4 (PDF page 86): 24 degree ki dhalan par motorcycle (kitab ki is example wali tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Free-body diagram: dashed dhalan dashed ufqi lakeer se 24 degree par. Dhalan ke ek nuqte par: F_N dhalan se bahar, raghrat (friction) f dhalan par oopar, mg sin 24 degree dhalan par neeche, wazan mg seedha neeche aur mg cos 24 degree dhalan ke andar, mg se 24 degree par. Patli lakeer mg aur mg cos 24 ki nokon ko jorti hai, us par mg sin 24.
blocks.caption: Example 4.4 (PDF page 86): dhalan par motorcycle par forces (kitab ki is example wali tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Wazan mg ke do hisse hain: mg cos 24 dhalan ke andar, jise F_N barabar kar deti hai, aur mg sin 24 dhalan ke saath neeche. Raghrat f oopar ki taraf hai, is liye khalis force F = mg sin 24 - f hai, jo motorcycle ko neeche le jati hai.
Ek din mein aap jo khana khate hain us mein taqreeban 1/3 litre petrol jitni energy hoti hai (Tid-bits).

blocks.caption: Theorem ko parhna
rows: Khalis force harkat ke khilaf (raghrat, doosri cheez ko dhakelta jism)
phir bhi KE ki tabdeeli ke barabar

blocks.prompt: 14 m s^-1 se chalti gend par force lagti hai aur us ki speed 6 m s^-1 kar deti hai. Us ne musbat kaam kiya ya manfi (constructed response 4.4)? Oonchai H se giraya jism 1.2 sqrt(gH) par zameen par pohnchta hai; hawa ki raghrat ka kiya kaam nikalein (short question 4.8).
blocks.explanation: Kinetic energy ghati, to theorem se gend par khalis kaam manfi hai: force ne harkat ki mukhalifat ki. Raghrat ke baghair utarne ki speed sqrt(2gH) hoti, jis se KE = mgH; asal KE (1/2) m (1.44 gH) = 0.72 mgH hai, to hawa ki raghrat ne -0.28 mgH kaam kiya (gravity ne +mgH kiya aur kul tabdeeli 0.72 mgH hai).

items: 2ad = vf^2 - vi^2 aur F = ma se: F d = (1/2) m vf^2 - (1/2) m vi^2 (4.18); khalis force ka kaam = KE ki tabdeeli, force ki kisi bhi simt aur badalti force ke liye bhi; manfi kaam KE ghatata hai. Example 4.4: 72 m neeche 20.4 m s^-1.
